'''Nuna salad''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] [[Species/Legends|species]], also commonly referred to as [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Turkey/Legends|turleys]].<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used nuna salad to make [[nuna salad sandwich]]es which he sold at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on [[Primeday/Legends|Primedays]].<ref name="Menu" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Nuna salad was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
